verdict.rationale: Only vendor marketing supports gaming performance: DLSS Super Resolution and Multi Frame Generation are said to boost FPS, and Blackwell is said to deliver path tracing 'at unprecedented speed'. None of it states 4K high-refresh frame rates, and no independent game benchmark corroborates it; the only community review covers cooling and noise, not FPS. Missing for 10: specific 4K/high-refresh performance claims, independent game benchmark results corroborating vendor claims, native (non-frame-generated) performance data.
